senses.gloss: धूम- + केतु धूम- + केतु, m. 1. fire, MBh. 1, 4162. 2. a meteor, MBh. 6, 80.
देव-, धूम्र-, राम- + गिरि देव-, धूम्र-, राम- + गिरि, m. names of mountains.

धूम धूम (vb. धू, or ध्मा), m. Smoke, Man. 4, 69.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. fumus; θυμός (originally breath), cf. ध्मा.

धूमक धूम + क,
 I. a substitute for धूम as latter part of comp. adj., e. g. स-, adj. Covered with smoke, Suśr. 2, 318, 7.
 II. f. मिका, Smoke, Kathās. 8, 28.
धूममय धूम + मय, adj., f. यी, Consisting of vapours, MBh. 5, 4059.

धूमय धूमय, a denomin. derived from धूम by अय, To cover with vapours, to eclipse, Rām. 5, 21, 9.
 --With the prep. प्र प्र, प्रधूमित, Covered with smoke, Ragh. 4, 2.

धूमाय धूमाय, a denomin. derived from धूम by य, Par., Ātm. To smoke, MBh. 3, 1319.
 2. To be covered with smoke, Chr. 41, 21.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. धूमयित, n. Smoking, MBh. 5, 4508.
 --Caus. धूमायय, To cause to be covered with smoke, MBh. 3, 1545.
धूमवत्त्व धूमवत्त्व, i. e. धूम-वन्त् + त्व, [] n. Condition of having smoke, Bhāṣāp. 75.
धूमवन्त् धुम + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Smoking, Tarkasaṃgr. 29.

धूम्र धूम्र, i. e. धूम + र (or rather an old धूमन् + अ, with र् for न्),
 I. adj., f. रा,
 1. Of a smoky colour.
 2. Black red, MBh. 1, 2033.
 3. Gray, Bhāg. P. 3, 14, 24.
 4. Obscured, Bhāg. P. 4, 29, 48.
 II. m. A proper name, Rām. 4, 33, 14.
 III. f. रा, A proper name, MBh. 1, 2583.
धूम- + प्राश धूम- + प्राश, adj. feeding only on smoke, MBh. 13, 646.
धूम्र- + लोहित धूम्र- + लोहित, adj. of a grey-red colour, MBh. 13, 753.

धूम्र- + वर्ण धूम्र- + वर्ण,
 I. adj. grey-coloured, Rām. 4, 39, 28.
 II. m. 1. the name of a mountain, Hariv. 12856. 2. a proper name, ib. 1799.
